arxiv-2102-01127.title: A Standard Model Explanation for the “ATOMKI Anomaly”
arxiv-2102-01127.creator: A. Aleksejevs, S. Barkanova, Yu.G. Kolomensky, B. Sheff
arxiv-2102-01127.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by A. Aleksejevs, S. Barkanova, Yu.G. Kolomensky, B. Sheff. Using the e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} pair spectrometer at the 5 MV Van de Graaff accelerator at the Institute for Nuclear Research, Hungarian Academy of Sciences (ATOMKI), Krasznahorkay et al. have claimed a 6.8 σ \sigma excess at high e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} opening angles in the internal pair creation isoscalar transition Be 8 ( 18.15 ) → 8 Be e + e − {}^{8}\mathrm{Be}(18.15)\to\,^{8}\mathrm{Be}\,e^{+}e^{-} .

arxiv-2109-00893.title: A Survey on Open Set Recognition
arxiv-2109-00893.creator: Atefeh Mahdavi, Marco Carvalho
arxiv-2109-00893.description: Abstract Open Set Recognition (OSR) is about dealing with unknown situations that were not learned by the models during training. In this paper, we provide a survey of existing works about OSR and distinguish their respective advantages and disadvantages to help out new researchers interested in the subject.

arxiv-2305-03164.title: Integrating Magnons for Quantum Information
arxiv-2305-03164.creator: Zhihao Jiang, Jinho Lim, Yi Li, Wolfgang Pfaff, Tzu-Hsiang Lo, Jiangchao Qian, André Schleife, Jian-Min Zuo, Valentine Novosad, Axel Hoffmann
arxiv-2305-03164.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zhihao Jiang, Jinho Lim, Yi Li, Wolfgang Pfaff, Tzu-Hsiang Lo, Jiangchao Qian, André Schleife, Jian-Min Zuo, Valentine Novosad, Axel Hoffmann. Magnons, the quanta of collective spin excitations in magnetically ordered materials, have distinct properties that make them uniquely appealing for quantum information applications. They can have ultra-small wavelengths down to the nanometer scale even at microwave frequencies. They can provide coupling to a diverse set of other quantum excitations, and their inherently gyrotropic dynamics forms the basis for pronounced non-reciprocities.

arxiv-2306-06681.title: New asymptotic representations of the noncentral t t -distribution
arxiv-2306-06681.creator: Amparo Gil, Javier Segura, Nico M. Temme
arxiv-2306-06681.description: Abstract New asymptotic approximations of the non-central t t distribution are given, a generalization of the Student’s t t distribution. Using new integral representations, we give new asymptotic expansions for large values of the noncentrality parameter but also for large values of the degrees of freedom parameter. In some case we accept more than one large parameter.

arxiv-2309-11985.title: Super-localised wave function approximation of Bose-Einstein condensates The work of D. Peterseim and C. Zimmer is part of a project that has received funding from the European Research Council (ERC) under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme (Grant agreement No. 86575
arxiv-2309-11985.creator: D. Peterseim, J. Wärnegård, C. Zimmer
arxiv-2309-11985.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel spatial discretisation method for the reliable and efficient simulation of Bose-Einstein condensates modelled by the Gross-Pitaevskii equation and the corresponding nonlinear eigenvector problem. The method combines the high-accuracy properties of numerical homogenisation methods with a novel super-localisation approach for the calculation of the basis functions.

arxiv-2404-07319.title: Non-trivial Integer Solutions of x r + y r = D ​ z p x^{r}+y^{r}=Dz^{p}
arxiv-2404-07319.creator: Yasemin Kara, Diana Mocanu, Ekin Özman
arxiv-2404-07319.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yasemin Kara, Diana Mocanu, Ekin Özman. In this paper, we use the modular method over totally real fields together with some standard conjectures (the Weak Frey–Mazur Conjecture and the Eichler–Shimura Conjecture) to prove that infinitely many equations of the type x r + y r = D ​ z p x^{r}+y^{r}=Dz^{p} do not have any non-trivial primitive integer solutions, where r ≥ 5 r\geq 5 is a fixed prime, whenever p p is large enough.

arxiv-2406-13341.title: Bootstrap percolation on the high-dimensional Hamming graph
arxiv-2406-13341.creator: Mihyun Kang, Michael Missethan, Dominik Schmid
arxiv-2406-13341.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Mihyun Kang, Michael Missethan, Dominik Schmid. In the random r r -neighbour bootstrap percolation process on a graph G G , a set of initially infected vertices is chosen at random by retaining each vertex of G G independently with probability p ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) p\in(0,1) , and ‘healthy’ vertices get infected in subsequent rounds if they have at least r r infected neighbours. A graph G G percolates if every vertex becomes eventually infected.

arxiv-2410-18558.creator: Shuhao Gu, Jialing Zhang, Siyuan Zhou, Kevin Yu, Zhaohu Xing, Liangdong Wang, Zhou Cao, Jintao Jia, Zhuoyi Zhang, Yixuan Wang, Zhenchong Hu, Bo-Wen Zhang, Jijie Li, Dong Liang, Yingli Zhao, Songjing Wang, Yulong Ao, Yiming Ju, Huanhuan Ma, Xiaotong Li, Haiwen Diao, Yufeng Cui, Xinlong Wang, Yaoqi Li

arxiv-2412-13272.title: Coherent Structures Governing Transport at Turbulent Interfaces
arxiv-2412-13272.creator: Ali R Khojasteh, Lyke E. van Dalen, Coen Been, Jerry Westerweel and Willem van de Water
arxiv-2412-13272.description: Abstract In an experiment on a turbulent jet, we detect interfacial turbulent layers in a frame that moves, on average, along with the turbulent-nonturbulent interface. This significantly prolongs the observation time of scalar and velocity structures and enables the measurement of two types of Lagrangian coherent structures.

arxiv-2505-01344.title: Multiplicative Congruences for Andrews’s Even Parts Below Odd Parts Function and Related Infinite Products
arxiv-2505-01344.creator: F. G. Garvan, Connor Morrow
arxiv-2505-01344.description: Abstract . We prove multiplicative congruences mod 2 12 2^{12} for George Andrews’s partition function, ℰ ​ 𝒪 ¯ ​ ( n ) \overline{\mathcal{EO}}(n) , the number of partitions of n n in which every even part is less than each odd part and only the largest even part occurs an odd number of times.

arxiv-2506-04199.title: Abundance Effects from Protoplanetary Disk Outflows
arxiv-2506-04199.creator: Åke Nordlund
arxiv-2506-04199.description: Abstract Context. Systematic abundance differences that depend on the condensation temperatures of elements have been observed, in particular for stars similar to the Sun; ‘solar twins’ and ‘solar analogues’. Similar differences have also recently been shown to exist between solar abundances and abundances of refractory elements in primitive chondrites.

pmc-10739438.title: UTILIZATION OF COMMUNITY CARE SERVICE AND SUBJECTIVE WELL-BEING OF OLDER PEOPLE: EVIDENCE FROM WEIFANG, CHINA
pmc-10739438.creator: Unknown
pmc-10739438.description: Many developed countries have established community-based care systems to address care needs of older people. However, community-based care in China is still in an early stage, some of its shortcomings are highlighted under the COVID-19 pandemic. Studying the wellbeing effect of community care in China could provide policy reference for developing countries.

pmc-11523791.title: miR-1226-5p is involved in radioresistance of colorectal cancer by activating M2 macrophages through suppressing IRF1
pmc-11523791.creator: Jae Yeon Choi, Hyun Jeong Seok, Dong Hyeon Lee, Junhye Kwon, Ui Sup Shin, Incheol Shin, In Hwa Bae
pmc-11523791.description: BackgroundAlthough the representative treatment for colorectal cancer (CRC) is radiotherapy, cancer cells survive due to inherent radioresistance or resistance acquired after radiation treatment, accelerating tumor malignancy and causing local recurrence and metastasis. However, the detailed mechanisms of malignancy induced after radiotherapy are not well understood.

pmc-11676662.creator: Cristina Georgiana Croitoru, Daniela Constantinescu, Mariana Pavel-Tanasa, Dan Iulian Cuciureanu, Corina Maria Cianga, Diana Nicoleta Hodorog, Petru Cianga, Cristoforo Comi, Junji Yamauchi
pmc-11676662.description: Background: Several significant associations between certain Human Leukocyte Antigen (HLA) alleles and myasthenia gravis (MG) subtypes were established in populations from Western Europe and North America and, to a lesser extent, from China and Japan. However, such data are scarcely available for Eastern Europe.

pmc-13348158.title: Comparison of overactive bladder symptoms and toileting behaviors between imams and male teachers: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13348158.creator: Anil Erdik, Haci Ibrahim Cimen, Kemal Demirhan, Deniz Gul
pmc-13348158.description: BackgroundToileting behaviors and occupational constraints are increasingly recognized as contributors to lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) and overactive bladder (OAB). Religious practices involving ritual ablution require pre-emptive voiding multiple times daily, yet no study has examined whether such behaviors influence OAB symptoms.

pmc-13380572.title: C-terminal Domain of the Heavy Chain of Tetanus Toxin Ameliorate Lipopolysaccharide Induced Hemiparkinsonism in Rats
pmc-13380572.creator: Irving Parra, José Aguilera, Yousef Tizabi, Liliana Mendieta
pmc-13380572.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Neuroinflammation is recognized as a central mechanism in Parkinson’s disease (PD) pathogenesis. The C-terminal domain of the heavy-chain of tetanus toxin (Hc-TeTx) has shown neuroprotective effects in toxin-based PD models, but its efficacy in inflammatory-induced PD conditions remain unexplored. To test this possibility, we used the hemiparkinsonism model induced by central injection of lipopolysaccharide (LPS) to evaluate potential antiinflammatory effects of Hc-TeTx in adult male Wistar rats. Seven days post LPS-injection motor coordination and gait maintenance were assessed using elevated beam test.

pmc-13392117.title: Experimental, numerical, and ARX model–based prediction of axial buckling capacity in stainless steel cylindrical shells
pmc-13392117.creator: Özer Zeybek, Ali İhsan Çelik, Yasin Onuralp Özkılıç
pmc-13392117.description: This study investigates the structural behavior of thin-walled cylindrical shells fabricated from stainless-steel pipe under uniform axial compressive loading. Pursuant to this goal, a combined experimental and FE parametric study was performed to develop more generalized design insights for long stainless-steel shell structures. Seventeen specimens with different diameters, thicknesses, and lengths were tested to characterize load–displacement behavior and failure modes.

pmc-13580181.title: Ligand Arm Length Governs Geometry, Spin State, and Reactivity in Unsymmetrical β‑Diketiminato Nickel(II) and Nickel(I) Complexes
pmc-13580181.creator: Tzu-Hsien Yang, Si-Hong Chen, Yu-Ting Chu, Ming-Li Tsai, Hsing-Yin Chen, Sodio C. N. Hsu
pmc-13580181.description: Unsymmetrical N-aryl-N′-alkylpyridyl β-diketiminate ligands (HL1 and HL2) enable fine control over the coordination geometry, spin-state, and reactivity of nickel­(II) and nickel­(I) complexes through variation in pyridyl chelating arm length. Treatment of NiCl2(2,4-lutidine)2 with deprotonated ligands HL1 and HL2 in THF afforded the corresponding complexes L1NiIICl and L2NiIICl, respectively.
